what: Settings of the three contrastive baselines (M1b SimGCL, M1c XSimGCL, M1d LightGCL). Each method's own hyperparameters were selected on validation NDCG@10 at seed 42 by scripts/contrastive_grid.py and frozen before any reported run; run_experiment.py applies them to these models unless a flag overrides them.
